info.name: The Void
info.description: The Void subclass for the Warlock from Steinhardt's Guide to the Eldritch Hunt (2024).
info.author: MonkeyDM

element.name: The Void
element.source: Steinhardt's Guide to the Eldritch Hunt (2024)

description.p: These Warlocks have made a pact with an eldritch being from the deepest depths of the Cosmos—a being that devours energy, holds the secrets of creation, and paves the way to the apocalypse. Pray that they are not aware of your presence. A deep fascination for the cosmos, or perhaps profound meditation on the heat death of the universe, could've brought about the circumstances that lead to this pact. Very few are able to withstand such knowledge and power, and the few that do are often seen as mysterious and reclusive figures.

Warlocks who strike a pact with the Void walk an eerie and dangerous path, focused on manipulating gravity and harnessing the immense power of black holes. Crushing their foes in condensed wells of gravity, whilst liberating themselves from the shackles that hold them, these Warlocks carve their own destiny under the guidance of the cosmos.

element.name: Level 3: Expanded Spell List
element.source: Steinhardt's Guide to the Eldritch Hunt (2024)

description.p: The magic of your patron ensures you always have certain spells ready; when you reach a Warlock level specified in the Void Spells table, you thereafter always have the listed spells prepared.

td.em: Feather Fall, Gravity Leap, Levitate, Otherworldly Gaze

element.name: Level 3: Fugite Omnis
element.source: Steinhardt's Guide to the Eldritch Hunt (2024)

description.p: You partially ignore the shackles of gravity and can hover up to one foot off the ground. You can ascend and descend as part of your movement, and you fall if you are above that height. If you would gain the Prone condition while hovering in this way, you are instead made to stand on the ground.

sheet.description: You can hover up to 1 ft off the ground (fall if higher). If you would become Prone while hovering, you instead stand on the ground.

element.name: Level 3: Voracious Void
element.source: Steinhardt's Guide to the Eldritch Hunt (2024)

description.p: As a Bonus Action, you can create a zone of impossible gravity, centered on an unoccupied space that you can see within 60 feet of yourself. It lasts for 1 minute and requires Concentration.
Once you use this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a Long Rest unless you expend a Pact Magic spell slot (no action required) to restore your use of it.

Black Hole. The gravity manifests as a 5-foot-diameter Sphere and is considered Difficult Terrain for creatures other than you. A creature that enters the Sphere for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there takes 1d6 Bludgeoning damage and has the Restrained condition while in the Sphere. If the Sphere isn't on the ground, creatures Restrained by it hover within it. A creature reduced to 0 Hit Points while in the Sphere is destroyed, along with any nonmagical objects it is wearing or carrying.

Escape. A Restrained creature can make a Strength (Athletics) check against your spell save DC at the end of each of its turns. On a success, the Restrained condition ends on the creature, and the creature is moved to the nearest unoccupied space outside the Sphere.
Influence Zone. The Black Hole's gravitational influence extends 5 feet beyond the Sphere.

Unsecured Objects. When the Black Hole appears and at the start of each of your turns, unsecured objects in the Influence Zone are pulled in a straight line toward the center, stopping in the nearest unoccupied space to the Sphere.

Gravitational Surge. When you create the Black Hole and as a Bonus Action on later turns, you can intensify the pull on one creature you can see in the Influence Zone. The target must succeed on a Strength saving throw against your spell save DC or be pulled in a straight line toward the center, stopping in the nearest unoccupied space to the Sphere.
At Higher Levels. This voracious void grows with you as your connection to your pact strengthens.
When you reach Warlock level 5, the Influence Zone increases to 10 feet beyond the Sphere and is considered Difficult Terrain for creatures other than you.
When you reach Warlock level 7, the diameter of the Black Hole increases to 10 feet, and you can summon it in spaces that are occupied by creatures.
When you reach Warlock level 9, the damage of the Black Hole increases to 2d6, and the Influence Zone increases to 20 feet beyond the Sphere.

sheet.description: Create a 5-ft diameter Black Hole within 60 ft (Conc., 1 min; 5-ft Influence Zone). Entering 1st time on turn or starting turn there: 1d6 Bludgeoning damage and Restrained (0 HP destroys creature and nonmagical gear; end-of-turn DC{{warlock:spellcasting:dc}} Athletics to escape). On create and Bonus Action on later turns, pull 1 creature in Influence Zone toward center (DC{{warlock:spellcasting:dc}} Str save). Expend a Pact Magic slot to restore use.

Create a 5-ft diameter Black Hole within 60 ft (Conc., 1 min; 10-ft Influence Zone, Difficult Terrain for others). Entering 1st time on turn or starting turn there: 1d6 Bludgeoning damage and Restrained (0 HP destroys creature and nonmagical gear; end-of-turn DC{{warlock:spellcasting:dc}} Athletics to escape). On create and Bonus Action on later turns, pull 1 creature in Influence Zone toward center (DC{{warlock:spellcasting:dc}} Str save). Expend a Pact Magic slot to restore use.

Create a 10-ft diameter Black Hole within 60 ft, even in occupied spaces (Conc., 1 min; 10-ft Influence Zone, Difficult Terrain for others). Entering 1st time on turn or starting turn there: 1d6 Bludgeoning damage and Restrained (0 HP destroys creature and nonmagical gear; end-of-turn DC{{warlock:spellcasting:dc}} Athletics to escape). On create and Bonus Action on later turns, pull 1 creature in Influence Zone toward center (DC{{warlock:spellcasting:dc}} Str save). Expend a Pact Magic slot to restore use.

Create a 10-ft diameter Black Hole within 60 ft, even in occupied spaces (Conc., 1 min; 20-ft Influence Zone, Difficult Terrain for others). Entering 1st time on turn or starting turn there: 2d6 Bludgeoning damage and Restrained (0 HP destroys creature and nonmagical gear; end-of-turn DC{{warlock:spellcasting:dc}} Athletics to escape). On create and Bonus Action on later turns, pull 1 creature in Influence Zone toward center (DC{{warlock:spellcasting:dc}} Str save). Expend a Pact Magic slot to restore use.

element.name: Level 6: Gravitational Pull
element.source: Steinhardt's Guide to the Eldritch Hunt (2024)

description.p: When a creature you can see within 60 feet of the Black Hole of your Voracious Void feature is targeted by a ranged attack, you can take a Reaction to divert the strike. Make a Charisma saving throw with a DC equal to the total of the attack roll. On a success, you deflect the projectile toward the center of the Black Hole, and the attack instead hits a randomly determined creature within it if any is present.
Starting at Warlock level 14, you always succeed on this saving throw.

sheet.description: When a creature within 60 ft of your Black Hole is targeted by a ranged attack, make a Cha save (DC = attack roll total) to deflect it into the Black Hole, hitting a random creature inside if any.
When a creature within 60 ft of your Black Hole is targeted by a ranged attack, you automatically deflect it into the Black Hole, hitting a random creature inside if any.

element.name: Level 10: Warp Gravity
element.source: Steinhardt's Guide to the Eldritch Hunt (2024)

description.p: You can bend gravity around you at will, allowing you to move through the air as if you were walking on solid ground. You gain a Fly Speed equal to your Speed and can hover. You can grant this benefit to one creature of your choice that is touching you. The benefit lasts until the target is no longer in contact with you or you give this benefit to another creature.

sheet.description: You have a Fly Speed of {{speed}} ft and can hover. You can grant this benefit to 1 creature touching you (lasts until contact ends or granted to another).

element.name: Level 14: Oblivion
element.source: Steinhardt's Guide to the Eldritch Hunt (2024)

description.p: You can unleash the ravenous hunger of the void. When you activate your Voracious Void feature, you can choose to let it run wild. In that case, a creature in the Influence Zone makes the saving throw against Gravitational Surge when you create the Black Hole and whenever it starts its turn there instead of as a Bonus Action. In addition, the damage of the Black Hole increases to 4d6. You and your choice of a number of creatures equal to your Charisma modifier (minimum of one) aren't affected by the Gravitational Surge.
Once you use this feature, you can't do so again until you finish a Long Rest.

sheet.description: When activating Voracious Void, let it run wild: Black Hole deals 4d6 Bludgeoning damage, and creatures in the Influence Zone save vs Gravitational Surge on creation and at the start of their turns (no Bonus Action needed). You and up to {{oblivion:immune}} chosen creatures are unaffected by Gravitational Surge.
